policy.additional_diagnostic: Descriptive author-style (max minus median)/median of decimal prices by side; report consensus favorite in 2%, 5%, 10% groups. No effect on predictions.
policy.dispersion: Maximum across sides of interquartile range of de-vigged named-brand probabilities. Fixed 1pp and 3pp cutpoints.
policy.formula: Normalize each H/D/A inverse-odds triple. Compare equal with weights proportional to 1/max(sum(inverse_odds)-1,0.0001).
policy.paired_intervals: 2000 seeded resamples of whole matchdays within each season. Deltas per match; negative loss differences favor candidate.
policy.proxy_warning: Source closing columns have no individual quote timestamps. No live or blind claim.
